answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a critical threshold mechanism where economic weight serves as the primary barrier against Sybil attacks. An agent must stake native tokens to validate, effectively creating a financial knoll that prevents identity proliferation. Attackers attempting to scale across the network ridge face exponential capital costs, forcing them onto a restrictive terrace of diminishing returns. This mechanism mandates that reputation or voting power is inextricably bound to provable, high-cost equity.
